$comment: Fixture schema for the Alk V2 golden corpus. Implementation-neutral. Not JSON Schema draft-strict; it is the documented shape every fixture file follows.

Fixture.title: one line

canonSource: rule or golden ids the fixture is taken from
provenance.note: for CANON_DERIVED: how the numbers were obtained from canonical formulas
provenance.$comment: CANON_VERBATIM: every asserted number appears in the canon. CANON_DERIVED: numbers computed here by applying frozen canonical formulas to inputs the canon states or to inputs constructed for this fixture. CANON_QUALITATIVE: the canon states states/prohibitions but no arithmetic. NO fixture derives an expectation from V1 runtime behaviour (DEC-013).

openIssues: open issue ids this fixture depends on or documents
Fixture.config: inline overrides of the referenced default configuration

input.events: chronological event ledger; each event has kind + fields per ALK-V2-DATA-CONTRACT.md

Fixture.expectedSupportedResult: supported slope, evidence state, trajectory - Layer 3
expectedReasonCodes: codes that MUST be present; the engine may emit additional INFO codes
Fixture.forbidden: states, values or codes that MUST NOT appear
Fixture.tolerance: overrides the default tolerance if the fixture needs one

acceptanceRule.$comment: From WORKED GOLDEN ROUND-1 and ROUND-2 ACCEPTANCE RULES.
aFixtureFailsIf: a numerical result differs beyond the declared tolerance
the wrong rule path produces the same final number
a forbidden state, value or reason code is returned
a required reason code is absent
a presentation layer recomputes a different slope or dose from the domain result

timeConvention.zone: Australia/Brisbane (UTC+10, no DST) - chosen so no fixture depends on a DST transition
